FAQ

Common questions about this service.

All questions
What happens after launch?

Every project includes an agreed support period after launch for fixes. After that, we offer ongoing maintenance and enhancements — updates, new features, and technical improvements — based on what your project needs.

Do you handle domains, hosting, and third-party services?

Yes. We can help you choose and connect a domain, set up hosting suitable for the project, and configure services such as payment gateways, shipping providers, email, and analytics. Accounts are created in your name wherever possible so you keep control.
